author: written with gpt-6 in codex

editor.scope: Isolated production-minified editor, native trusted input, no persistence or app callbacks. Instrumented timings are exploratory and not additive to the original whole-app benchmark.

session.scope: Real DocumentSession and SQLite adapters, static transport isolates network; single exploratory sample per size. Initial/cached open below means graph hydration, not painted UI.

browserOpenProfile.scope: One production 32KB reload under profiling and shared-host load; inclusive times overlap.

failure.cause: body.push(...raw.slice(position)) exceeds Chromium function argument limit; no recursion required.

cache.effect: Leaving a document releases its session; reopening revalidates and rehydrates its state. Existing-document switching remains a valid product journey comparison.
cache.lifecycleCaveat: RcMap entry scope also owns live.watch, sync streams and IndexedDB resources. Retain passive materialization separately from foreground collaboration scope; increasing TTL alone can retain obsolete watches/presence.

review: Two read-only Claude Opus 5.5 reviews corroborated the causes. Predictions such as TTL gains remain unmeasured.
recommendations: Replace unbounded argument spreads within the supported size limit; cover browser open, paste, delete and frontmatter edits.
Index overlay text offsets and batch geometry reads before DOM writes; coalesce redundant paints.
Gate overlay updates by source/projection revision; render and measure visible regions.
Avoid whole-source temporary atom arrays, unnecessary visible-ID sets and repeated freezing of already frozen immutable atoms.
Decode/validate snapshots once at boundaries; preserve isolation of accepted, durable and optimistic state.
Retain a bounded number of recent document states through Effect RcMap, reviewing scope, permission, presence and memory behavior.
Use a compact checkpoint representation instead of expanded per-character JSON; avoid loading whole old snapshots just to compare their positions.
